scope: Public NASA Eileen Collins fixture only; no physical-camera pixels supplied to image review

directReview.observation: All preserve the face, suit and helmet silhouette. Photo removes Original's contour texture from the face and suit for continuous photographic shading; its difference from Print is subtle in a full Fit view but visible in the native glyph crop. Print has a regular ordered pattern rather than Photo's diffused pattern. Outline intentionally empties interiors and retains identifiable directional contours.
directReview.decision: Retain the four curated choices. Photo is a contour-free alternative, not a universal improvement. The independent weak-purpose Photo judgment is not rewritten.

directReview.observation: The source is square, so square framing is expected to match Full. Returning to neutral Original and Full exactly restores all 80199 characters; baseline and final SHA256 d429e415b583fd3d39d060f5c350fbbfbb26cff82d5c164ad3245abf88bb942d. Novelty is not the acceptance criterion for a mandatory unchanged baseline or a restore action.

Center cropping removes the expected outer bands without stretching. Wide crops intentionally cut the top/bottom of a portrait; tall crops remove side background. Guides follow artwork rather than black letterboxing. Fit keeps the complete selected crop visible and controls remain outside the scrollport. Cropping is not content-aware and does not promise to preserve the entire subject.
directReview.decision: Retain nondestructive ratios, document center-crop tradeoff, keep Full as the unchanged default.

directReview.observation: Tint is consistent between Camera and Studio, leaving source/text identity unchanged. Optional glow adds visible warm character illumination without control overlap. The 8px gutter contains the halo in Fit and Detail. Same-host 15fps delivery, animation interval and Stop observations show no material interaction regression; this is not mobile hardware validation.
directReview.decision: Retain tint and optional bounded glow off by default; no GPU or universal FPS claim.

directReview.observation: Auto contrast restores useful separation in the public low-contrast photograph. Midtone 0.65 lightens the dark source. Sharpness changes Outline contour structure before edge selection; inversion changes processed luminance rather than tint. A toggling highlight causes about 50 luminance units of global auto-contrast pumping in an unchanged region.
directReview.decision: Keep tone adjustments opt-in. Warn explicitly that auto contrast adapts every frame and moving highlights can flicker; no hidden stabilization or fallback added.

hardwareLimitations: iPhone screenshots are Chromium/WebKit desktop emulation, not physical iPhone Safari
